import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, _split_text, split_graphemes


def test_split_text_at_zero_basic():
    """Test splitting at column zero returns empty left and full text on right."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"


def test_split_text_at_zero_empty_string():
    """Test splitting empty string at column zero."""
    text = ""
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == ""


def test_split_text_at_zero_with_double_width():
    """Test splitting text with double-width characters at column zero."""
    text = "你好"  # Two double-width Chinese characters
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "你好"


def test_split_text_at_zero_mixed_width():
    """Test splitting mixed single and double-width text at column zero."""
    text = "a你b"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "a你b"


def test_split_text_negative_returns_empty_left():
    """Test that negative positions return empty left."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, -1)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"


def test_split_text_in_middle():
    """Test splitting in the middle still works."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    assert left == "he"
    assert right == "llo"


def test_split_text_at_end():
    """Test splitting at or past the end."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 5)
    assert left == "hello"
    assert right == ""
    
    left, right = split_text(text, 10)
    assert left == "hello"
    assert right == ""


def test_split_text_double_width_split_in_middle():
    """Test splitting at position inside a double-width character replaces with spaces."""
    text = "a你b"  # 'a' is 1 cell, '你' is 2 cells, 'b' is 1 cell = 4 cells total
    # Position 2 is inside the '你' character
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    # Should get 'a ' on left and ' b' on right
    assert left == "a "
    assert right == " b"

import pytest
from rich.cells import _split_text, split_graphemes


def test_split_text_internal_zero_double_width():
    """Test _split_text at zero with double-width characters."""
    text = "你好世"
    left, right = _split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "你好世"


def test_split_text_internal_zero_single_cell():
    """Test _split_text at zero with single-cell characters."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = _split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"


def test_split_graphemes_simple():
    """Test split_graphemes returns correct spans."""
    text = "hello"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 5
    assert total_width == 5
    # Each span should be (start, end, width)
    for i, (start, end, width) in enumerate(spans):
        assert start == i
        assert end == i + 1
        assert width == 1


def test_split_graphemes_double_width():
    """Test split_graphemes with double-width characters."""
    text = "a你"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 2
    assert total_width == 3  # 1 for 'a', 2 for '你'
    assert spans[0] == (0, 1, 1)
    assert spans[1] == (1, 2, 2)


def test_split_text_zero_mixed():
    """Test _split_text at zero with mixed width."""
    text = "h你w"
    left, right = _split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "h你w"

from rich.cells import cell_len


def test_cell_len_empty():
    """Test cell_len of empty string."""
    assert cell_len("") == 0

    """Test cell_len of single-cell characters."""
    assert cell_len("a") == 1
    assert cell_len("hello") == 5


def test_cell_len_double_cell():
    """Test cell_len of double-cell characters."""
    assert cell_len("你") == 2
    assert cell_len("你好") == 4


def test_cell_len_mixed():
    """Test cell_len of mixed width text."""
    assert cell_len("a你b") == 4  # 1 + 2 + 1


def test_cell_len_zero_width_joiner():
    """Test cell_len with zero-width joiner."""
    # Zero-width joiner shouldn't add to length
    text = "a\u200db"
    length = cell_len(text)
    # Should be 1 for 'a', 0 for ZWJ, 1 for 'b'
    assert length <= 2


def test_cell_len_spaces():
    """Test cell_len of spaces."""
    assert cell_len("   ") == 3

import pytest
from rich.cells import set_cell_size


def test_set_cell_size_exact_fit():
    """Test set_cell_size when text fits exactly."""
    result = set_cell_size("hello", 5)
    assert result == "hello"
    assert len(result) == 5


def test_set_cell_size_pad():
    """Test set_cell_size pads with spaces."""
    result = set_cell_size("hi", 5)
    assert result == "hi   "
    assert len(result) == 8  # "hi" + 3 spaces


def test_set_cell_size_crop():
    """Test set_cell_size crops text."""
    result = set_cell_size("hello", 3)
    assert result == "hel"


def test_set_cell_size_crop_double_width():
    """Test set_cell_size crops at double-width character boundary."""
    # If a double-width char would be partially included, it gets replaced with space
    result = set_cell_size("h你", 2)
    assert result == "h "


def test_set_cell_size_zero():
    """Test set_cell_size with zero width."""
    result = set_cell_size("hello", 0)
    assert result == ""


def test_set_cell_size_negative():
    """Test set_cell_size with negative width."""
    result = set_cell_size("hello", -5)
    assert result == ""
